promises.text: Describe who posts about municipal council politics on the platform and how discussion relates to the council calendar.
Use all public posts in the local-politics boards from 2019 to 2023, obtained through the export interface.
Report concentration of posting, timing relative to council meetings, and the share of uncivil posts coded with a validated classifier.
Compare all three quantities with a second regional platform.
Provide a table of key values per municipality size class.
